title: Read a list item
summary: Ruby: Read a list item. Read position 0.
introduction: An array keeps values in order. The first index is zero. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Read a list item with Ruby

blocks.text: Install Ruby 3.1 or later. Save one example as lesson.rb and run ruby lesson.rb in a terminal.
The array positions are 0 and 1. The second position contains dog.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: An index past the list gives nil, not a new item.
